actors.name: PTA Subcommittee for the Winter Fair
actors.private_context: The subcommittee is responsible for organizing the winter fair and needs to recruit four stall coordinators. It has a meeting scheduled for October 19, 2026. The subcommittee has not yet recruited any stall coordinators as of the simulation start.

shared_context: The PTA subcommittee for the winter fair is seeking four stall coordinators. The subcommittee will hold its October planning meeting on 2026-10-19 at 21:00. Potential coordinators may be recruited before or at that meeting.

starting_events.description: The PTA subcommittee begins its recruitment efforts for four stall coordinators.
visible_to: PTA Subcommittee for the Winter Fair

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that four stall coordinators have been recruited (i.e., have agreed to serve) by the end of the October planning meeting (2026-10-19T21:00:00-05:00). Otherwise resolve NO.
